description: Data layer foundation: enums, entity POCOs, Fluent API configurations, DbContext, repository interfaces, generic Repository<T>/UnitOfWork implementations, and all specific repository implementations. This is the bottom of the dependency stack — every other FEAT depends on it. Independent of FEAT-002 through FEAT-005.
steps: 1. Create Exceptions/ folder and three domain exception types. Files: DCDSS/Exceptions/NotFoundException.cs (inherits Exception, ctor(string message)), DCDSS/Exceptions/ConflictException.cs (inherits Exception, ctor(string message)), DCDSS/Exceptions/BusinessRuleException.cs (inherits Exception, ctor(string message)). Namespace DCDSS.Exceptions.

2. Create all 7 enums in DCDSS/Entities/Enums/. Each is a plain public enum in namespace DCDSS.Entities.Enums. Files: UserRole.cs { Doctor, Nurse, LaboratoryStaff, Administrator }; Gender.cs { Male, Female, Other }; BloodType.cs { APositive, ANegative, BPositive, BNegative, ABPositive, ABNegative, OPositive, ONegative }; MedicalRecordStatus.cs { Active, Resolved, Archived }; LabResultStatus.cs { Ordered, Normal, High, Low, Indeterminate }; MedicationStatus.cs { Active, Discontinued }; AppointmentStatus.cs { Scheduled, Completed, Cancelled }.

3. Create 8 entity POCOs in DCDSS/Entities/. Namespace DCDSS.Entities. No data annotations — mapping is all Fluent API. Files and their required properties:
   - User.cs: int UserId; string Username; string PasswordHash; string FullName; string Email; UserRole Role; string? Department; DateTime CreatedAt; navigation collections: ICollection<MedicalRecord> AuthoredMedicalRecords; ICollection<LabResult> OrderedLabResults; ICollection<Appointment> Appointments; ICollection<AuditLog> AuditLogs.
   - Patient.cs: int PatientId; string FirstName; string Surname; Gender Gender; DateOnly DateOfBirth; string Address; string Phone; BloodType BloodType; string? EmergencyContact; DateTime CreatedAt; ICollection<MedicalRecord> MedicalRecords; ICollection<Appointment> Appointments; ICollection<PatientAllergy> Allergies.
   - PatientAllergy.cs: int PatientAllergyId; int PatientId; string Allergen; Patient Patient.
   - MedicalRecord.cs: int RecordId; int PatientId; int DoctorId; string Diagnosis; string? TreatmentNotes; DateTime VisitDate; MedicalRecordStatus Status; Patient Patient; User Doctor; ICollection<LabResult> LabResults; ICollection<Medication> Medications.
   - LabResult.cs: int ResultId; int RecordId; string TestName; string? ResultValue; string ReferenceRange; LabResultStatus Status; int OrderedBy; DateTime DateOrdered; MedicalRecord Record; User OrderedByUser.
   - Medication.cs: int MedicationId; int RecordId; string DrugName; string Dosage; string Frequency; DateTime StartDate; MedicationStatus Status; MedicalRecord Record.
   - Appointment.cs: int AppointmentId; int PatientId; int DoctorId; DateTime AppointmentDate; AppointmentStatus Status; Patient Patient; User Doctor.
   - AuditLog.cs: int AuditId; int? UserId; string Action; string? Details; DateTime Timestamp; User? User.

4. Create DCDSS/Data/DcdssContext.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Data. Inherits DbContext. Constructor: DcdssContext(DbContextOptions<DcdssContext> options) : base(options). DbSet properties: DbSet<User> Users; DbSet<Patient> Patients; DbSet<PatientAllergy> PatientAllergies; DbSet<MedicalRecord> MedicalRecords; DbSet<LabResult> LabResults; DbSet<Medication> Medications; DbSet<Appointment> Appointments; DbSet<AuditLog> AuditLogs. Override OnModelCreating: call modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof(DcdssContext).Assembly).

5. Create 8 Fluent API configuration files in DCDSS/Data/Configurations/. Each implements IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Namespace DCDSS.Data.Configurations. Shared rules for all: HasKey on PK, ValueGeneratedOnAdd, HasColumnName to restore schema column names (UserID/PatientID etc.), enums use HasConversion<string>() + HasMaxLength, all FKs use OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict), Required/MaxLength/IsRequired as per Section 3 table.

   UserConfiguration.cs:
   - PK UserId → column UserID, ValueGeneratedOnAdd.
   - Username: Required, MaxLength(50), HasColumnName(Username). HasIndex(u=>u.Username).IsUnique().
   - PasswordHash: Required, MaxLength(512), HasColumnName(PasswordHash).
   - FullName: Required, MaxLength(100), HasColumnName(FullName).
   - Email: Required, MaxLength(150), HasColumnName(Email). HasIndex(u=>u.Email).IsUnique().
   - Role: Required, HasConversion<string>(), MaxLength(20), HasColumnName(Role).
   - Department: Optional, MaxLength(100), HasColumnName(Department).
   - CreatedAt: Required, HasColumnName(CreatedAt), HasDefaultValueSql("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)").
   - Navigations: HasMany(AuthoredMedicalRecords).WithOne(Doctor).HasForeignKey(mr=>mr.DoctorId).OnDelete(Restrict). HasMany(OrderedLabResults).WithOne(OrderedByUser).HasForeignKey(lr=>lr.OrderedBy).OnDelete(Restrict). HasMany(Appointments).WithOne(Doctor).HasForeignKey(a=>a.DoctorId).OnDelete(Restrict). HasMany(AuditLogs).WithOne(User).HasForeignKey(al=>al.UserId).OnDelete(Restrict).IsRequired(false).

   PatientConfiguration.cs:
   - PK PatientId → column PatientID.
   - FirstName/Surname: Required MaxLength(50).
   - Gender: HasConversion<string>() MaxLength(10).
   - DateOfBirth: Required, HasColumnName(DOB), mapped to MySQL DATE (Pomelo handles DateOnly→DATE automatically).
   - Address: Required MaxLength(200). Phone: Required MaxLength(20). BloodType: HasConversion<string>() MaxLength(12). EmergencyContact: Optional MaxLength(100).
   - CreatedAt: HasDefaultValueSql("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)").
   - HasMany(MedicalRecords).WithOne(Patient).HasForeignKey(mr=>mr.PatientId).OnDelete(Restrict). HasMany(Appointments).WithOne(Patient).HasForeignKey(a=>a.PatientId).OnDelete(Restrict). HasMany(Allergies).WithOne(Patient).HasForeignKey(pa=>pa.PatientId).OnDelete(Restrict).

   PatientAllergyConfiguration.cs:
   - PK PatientAllergyId → column PatientAllergyID.
   - PatientId: Required, HasColumnName(PatientID), FK configured via PatientConfiguration (or use HasOne/WithMany here: HasOne(pa=>pa.Patient).WithMany(p=>p.Allergies).HasForeignKey(pa=>pa.PatientId).OnDelete(Restrict)).
   - Allergen: Required MaxLength(100). HasIndex(pa=>new{pa.PatientId,pa.Allergen}).IsUnique(). HasIndex(pa=>pa.PatientId).

   MedicalRecordConfiguration.cs:
   - PK RecordId → column RecordID. PatientId/DoctorId: Required, HasColumnName(PatientID/DoctorID). Diagnosis: Required MaxLength(500). TreatmentNotes: Optional MaxLength(2000). VisitDate: Required. Status: HasConversion<string>() MaxLength(20) HasDefaultValue(MedicalRecordStatus.Active).
   - Indexes: HasIndex(mr=>mr.PatientId). HasIndex(mr=>mr.DoctorId). HasIndex(mr=>mr.VisitDate).
   - HasMany(LabResults).WithOne(Record).HasForeignKey(lr=>lr.RecordId).OnDelete(Restrict). HasMany(Medications).WithOne(Record).HasForeignKey(m=>m.RecordId).OnDelete(Restrict).
   - DoctorId FK to User is on UserConfiguration side; ensure no duplicate config.

   LabResultConfiguration.cs:
   - PK ResultId → column ResultID. RecordId: Required HasColumnName(RecordID). TestName: Required MaxLength(100). ResultValue: Optional MaxLength(50). ReferenceRange: Required MaxLength(100). Status: HasConversion<string>() MaxLength(20) HasDefaultValue(LabResultStatus.Ordered). OrderedBy: Required HasColumnName(OrderedBy) (FK to Users configured on UserConfiguration side). DateOrdered: Required HasDefaultValueSql("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)").
   - Indexes: HasIndex(lr=>lr.RecordId). HasIndex(lr=>lr.OrderedBy). HasIndex(lr=>lr.DateOrdered).

   MedicationConfiguration.cs:
   - PK MedicationId → column MedicationID. RecordId: Required HasColumnName(RecordID). DrugName: Required MaxLength(100). Dosage: Required MaxLength(50). Frequency: Required MaxLength(50). StartDate: Required HasDefaultValueSql("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)"). Status: HasConversion<string>() MaxLength(20) HasDefaultValue(MedicationStatus.Active).
   - HasIndex(m=>m.RecordId).

   AppointmentConfiguration.cs:
   - PK AppointmentId → column AppointmentID. PatientId/DoctorId: Required HasColumnName(PatientID/DoctorID). AppointmentDate: Required. Status: HasConversion<string>() MaxLength(20) HasDefaultValue(AppointmentStatus.Scheduled).
   - Indexes: HasIndex(a=>a.PatientId). HasIndex(a=>a.DoctorId). HasIndex(a=>a.AppointmentDate).

   AuditLogConfiguration.cs:
   - PK AuditId → column AuditID. UserId: Optional (IsRequired(false)) HasColumnName(UserID). Action: Required MaxLength(50). Details: Optional MaxLength(1000). Timestamp: Required HasDefaultValueSql("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)").
   - Indexes: HasIndex(al=>al.UserId). HasIndex(al=>al.Timestamp).

6. Create repository abstractions. Files:
   DCDSS/Services/Interfaces/IRepository.cs — namespace DCDSS.Services.Interfaces: public interface IRepository<T> where T : class { Task<T?> GetByIdAsync(int id); Task<IList<T>> GetAllAsync(); Task AddAsync(T entity); void Update(T entity); void Remove(T entity); IQueryable<T> Query(); }
   DCDSS/Services/Interfaces/IUnitOfWork.cs — public interface IUnitOfWork { Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken ct = default); }
   DCDSS/Repositories/Interfaces/IUserRepository.cs — extends IRepository<User>: Task<User?> GetByUsernameAsync(string username); Task<User?> GetByEmailAsync(string email).
   DCDSS/Repositories/Interfaces/IPatientRepository.cs — extends IRepository<Patient>: Task<(IList<Patient> Items, int Total)> SearchAsync(int page, int pageSize, string? search); Task<Patient?> GetByIdWithHistoryAsync(int id).
   DCDSS/Repositories/Interfaces/IPatientAllergyRepository.cs — (does NOT extend IRepository<T>): Task<IList<PatientAllergy>> GetByPatientAsync(int patientId); Task DeleteByPatientAsync(int patientId); Task AddAsync(PatientAllergy allergy).
   DCDSS/Repositories/Interfaces/IMedicalRecordRepository.cs — extends IRepository<MedicalRecord>: (no extra methods beyond base — GetByIdAsync from base is sufficient; services call the base method).
   DCDSS/Repositories/Interfaces/ILabResultRepository.cs — extends IRepository<LabResult>: Task<IList<LabResult>> GetByPatientAsync(int patientId).
   DCDSS/Repositories/Interfaces/IMedicationRepository.cs — extends IRepository<Medication>: Task<IList<Medication>> GetActiveByPatientAsync(int patientId).
   DCDSS/Repositories/Interfaces/IAppointmentRepository.cs — extends IRepository<Appointment>: Task<IList<Appointment>> GetByDoctorAsync(int doctorId).
   DCDSS/Repositories/Interfaces/IAuditLogRepository.cs — extends IRepository<AuditLog>: Task<(IList<AuditLog> Items, int Total)> GetPagedAsync(int page, int pageSize).

7. Create generic Repository<T> base and UnitOfWork in DCDSS/Repositories/. Namespace DCDSS.Repositories.
   Repository.cs: public class Repository<T> : IRepository<T> where T : class. Constructor: (DcdssContext context). Private field _context. GetByIdAsync: _context.Set<T>().FindAsync(id). GetAllAsync: _context.Set<T>().ToListAsync(). AddAsync: _context.Set<T>().AddAsync(entity). Update: _context.Set<T>().Update(entity). Remove: _context.Set<T>().Remove(entity). Query(): _context.Set<T>().AsQueryable().
   UnitOfWork.cs: public class UnitOfWork : IUnitOfWork. Constructor: (DcdssContext context). SaveChangesAsync: _context.SaveChangesAsync(ct).

8. Create all 8 specific repository implementations in DCDSS/Repositories/. Each inherits Repository<T> and implements its specific interface. Namespace DCDSS.Repositories.

   UserRepository.cs: ctor(DcdssContext ctx):base(ctx). GetByUsernameAsync: Query().FirstOrDefaultAsync(u=>u.Username==username). GetByEmailAsync: Query().FirstOrDefaultAsync(u=>u.Email==email).

   PatientRepository.cs: ctor(DcdssContext ctx). SearchAsync: var q = Query(); if search not empty: q = q.Where(p => p.FirstName.Contains(search)||p.Surname.Contains(search)); int total = await q.CountAsync(); var items = await q.OrderBy(p=>p.Surname).Skip((page-1)*pageSize).Take(pageSize).ToListAsync(); return (items, total). GetByIdWithHistoryAsync: Query().Include(p=>p.Allergies).Include(p=>p.MedicalRecords).ThenInclude(mr=>mr.LabResults).Include(p=>p.MedicalRecords).ThenInclude(mr=>mr.Medications).Include(p=>p.MedicalRecords).ThenInclude(mr=>mr.Doctor).FirstOrDefaultAsync(p=>p.PatientId==id).

   PatientAllergyRepository.cs: does NOT inherit Repository<T> (it is not IRepository<T>). Constructor(DcdssContext ctx). GetByPatientAsync: ctx.PatientAllergies.Where(pa=>pa.PatientId==patientId).ToListAsync(). DeleteByPatientAsync: var rows = await ctx.PatientAllergies.Where(pa=>pa.PatientId==patientId).ToListAsync(); ctx.PatientAllergies.RemoveRange(rows). AddAsync: ctx.PatientAllergies.AddAsync(allergy).

   MedicalRecordRepository.cs: inherits Repository<MedicalRecord>. No extra methods (GetByIdAsync from base is sufficient).

   LabResultRepository.cs: GetByPatientAsync: Query().Include(lr=>lr.Record).Where(lr=>lr.Record.PatientId==patientId).OrderByDescending(lr=>lr.DateOrdered).ToListAsync().

   MedicationRepository.cs: GetActiveByPatientAsync: Query().Include(m=>m.Record).Where(m=>m.Record.PatientId==patientId && m.Status==MedicationStatus.Active).ToListAsync().

   AppointmentRepository.cs: GetByDoctorAsync: Query().Include(a=>a.Patient).Include(a=>a.Doctor).Where(a=>a.DoctorId==doctorId).OrderBy(a=>a.AppointmentDate).ToListAsync().

   AuditLogRepository.cs: GetPagedAsync: var q = Query().Include(al=>al.User).OrderByDescending(al=>al.Timestamp); int total = await q.CountAsync(); var items = await q.Skip((page-1)*pageSize).Take(pageSize).ToListAsync(); return (items, total).
acceptance_criteria: All 7 enum files compile with no errors.
All 8 entity POCO files compile with no errors.
DcdssContext has all 8 DbSet<T> properties and calls ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly.
All 8 IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> files compile — each references only the entity type and DbContext.
IRepository<T> and IUnitOfWork are in Services/Interfaces/ namespace (Core).
Repository<T> and UnitOfWork are in Repositories/ namespace (Data).
All 8 specific repository interfaces are in Repositories/Interfaces/.
All 8 specific repository implementations are in Repositories/ and inherit Repository<T> where appropriate.
PatientAllergyRepository does NOT inherit Repository<T> — it implements IPatientAllergyRepository directly.

findings: PatientConfiguration deliberately duplicates the HasMany/WithOne for Allergies because PatientAllergyConfiguration also has HasOne/WithMany on the same relationship — EF Core resolves this consistently (last-registered wins, both declare the same FK/delete). No schema impact. Later FEATs: use IDbContextFactory<DcdssContext> for AuditLogService (not DcdssContext directly). AddDbContextFactory only — not AddDbContext. All repository implementations are in DCDSS.Repositories namespace and inherit Repository<T> except PatientAllergyRepository which implements IPatientAllergyRepository directly. LabResultRepository, MedicationRepository, and AppointmentRepository use ContinueWith to cast List<T> to IList<T> — downstream callers receive the correct interface type.
